page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head and page number at the top right; a historiated initial "E" opening the casus; small marginal reference marks at the left and right edges of the body; catchword "ut" and signature "A 2" at the foot.

main_text.l: pace jam cum Gallis inità, postquam paulò
dendorum causa, infesta in Galliam arma in-
tulisset. Itaq; in Galliarum Regis Consistorio
quæsitum est: An Soror Regis in matrimonium
Britanno dari, an aliis, & utilioribus Galliæ
dari eam non oportere, quòd ex eo parum vel
nihil utilitatis in Gallorum Regnum & publi-
cum bonum redundaturum esset. Enim verò si
quid esset ex illo utilitatis eventurum, hoc fore ut

page.notes: The initial "E" is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "E" followed by "RAT". The catchword "ut" and signature "A 2" are at the foot. Small reference marks at the edges of the body text are not legible as notes and are omitted. The line "Enim verò si" and "quid esset" are as printed; the final word "fore" is printed with a long-s style ending and read as "fore".
